comment: Crash loops as Docker shows them, for the crash-loop rule. health/tests.rs (the Mac) and agent_test.py (the agent) run every case.
Runner: one sample of the container every sampleS seconds from t = 0 while t < the phases' total length. 'phases' play in
order; {repeat: n, phases: [...]} plays its phases n times. A sample's state is its phase's state. restartCount starts at 0
and rises by 1 at the first sample of each 'restarting' phase, and at the first sample of a phase marked restarted (Docker
restarted it between two samples). While 'running', startedAt is startS + the t its phase began; otherwise 0. With
endpoint.answering the model the container serves answers on every sample (endpoint health ready, the container a member).
Feed each sample to the rule set's crash-loop rule (default-rules.json: warn above 0 restarts, critical above 1, in a
600 s window; restarting is critical) and the alert engine at startS + t, then every event through the gate (default
settings: resolves on, repeats every 60 min, no quiet hours) with a tick at every sample, and flush every sample.
Settled: running for at least crashRecentS, or the model answering. Last restart: the last sample of a restarting phase,
or the first sample of a restarted phase. Expected: exactly the raises listed (severity and t) and no other raise,
escalation or easing; one resolve, at a t within resolvedBetween (never before crashRecentS after the last restart, never
later than crashWindowS after it plus one sample), or none when resolvedBetween is null; at most messagesAtMost messages
out of the gate over the whole run.

cases.name: D1 an 8 s running, 12 s restarting loop for 5 minutes, then up: one raise, one resolve
D2 one crash, restarted once, then up: one raise, one resolve
D3 a slow loop, 90 s up and 10 s restarting, stays one alert
D4 restarted between two samples while its model answers: nothing to page
D5 the same restart with no model to vouch for it is a warning, raised once
D6 a loop every 30 s for 10 minutes stays critical and pages once
